title: समकालीन नेपाली कथामा प्रयुक्त कथानकका स्रोत
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेखमा समकालीन नेपाली कथाहरुलाई पाठका रुपमा लिई तिनमा प्रयुक्त कथानकका स्रोतहरुको पहिचान र समाख्यानात्मक प्रभावकारिताको मूल्याङ्कन गरिएको छ । २०६२÷६३ सालको लोकतान्त्रिक आन्दोलनपछिका समकालीन नेपाली कथाहरुमा प्रयुक्त कथानककास्रोतका रुपमा यथार्थमूलक अनुभव, इतिहास, मिथक, रागात्मक सौन्दर्य र स्वैरकल्पनालाई लिइएको छ भन्ने देखाई कथामा ती स्रोतका विषयक्षेत्रका घटना, पात्र, परिवेश र चिन्तनले खेलेको भूमिकालाई स्थापित गर्नु यस लेखको उद्देश्य हो । यसमा कथानकको स्रोतविश्लेषणका निम्ति सोद्देश्यमूलक रुपमादस कथा छनोट गरी कथानकका स्रोतसम्बन्धी आधारभूत मान्यतालाई सैद्धान्तिक ढाँचाका रूपमा अवलम्बनका साथ पाठगत विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । यसमा यथार्थमूलक अनुभव र रागात्मक सौन्दर्यलाई स्रोतका रुपमा लिइएका कथाहरुसँग पाठकीय निकटता अधिक रहेको र इतिहास, मिथक एवम् स्वैरकल्पनालाई स्रोतका रुपमा लिएका कथाहरुमा पुजर्सिर्जना रहने हुँदा बौद्धिकता र साङ्केतिकताको अधिकताका कारण कलात्मक प्रभावकारिता समृद्ध भएको देखिएको छ भने अधिकांश कथा एकल स्रोतका रहे पनि स्रोतगत मिश्रणको सम्भावनाबाट समेत केही कथाले नवीनता पाएको निष्कर्ष यस लेखमा निकालिएको छ ।
american_english: In this article, taking contemporary Nepali stories as texts, the sources of the plots used in them have been identified and the narrative effectiveness has been evaluated. It is shown that in contemporary Nepali stories after the democratic movement of 2062/63 B.S., reality-based experience, history, myth, emotional beauty, and free imagination have been taken as sources of plot, and the objective of this article is to establish the role played by events, characters, settings, and thought from the subject areas of those sources in the stories. In this study, ten stories were purposively selected for the analysis of plot sources, and textual analysis was carried out by adopting basic assumptions related to plot sources as a theoretical framework. In this, stories that take reality-based experience and emotional beauty as sources show greater readerly closeness, while in stories that take history, myth, and free imagination as sources, because there is re-creation, artistic effectiveness is seen to be enriched due to a greater presence of intellectuality and symbolism; and although most stories have a single source, this article concludes that some stories have also gained novelty even from the possibility of a mixing of sources.

informal_english: In this article, taking contemporary Nepali stories as texts, I’ve identified the sources of the plots used in them and checked out how effective they are narratively. It shows that in contemporary Nepali stories after the democratic movement of 2062/63 B.S., reality-based experience, history, myth, emotional beauty, and free imagination have been used as sources of plot, and the goal of this article is to lay out the role played by events, characters, settings, and ideas from the subject areas of those sources in the stories. For this, I purposely picked ten stories to analyze plot sources and carried out a textual analysis, using basic assumptions related to plot sources as a theoretical framework. In this, stories that use reality-based experience and emotional beauty as sources feel closer to the reader, while in stories that use history, myth, and free imagination as sources, because there’s re-creation, the artistic impact comes across as richer thanks to more intellectuality and symbolism; and even though most stories stick to a single source, this article concludes that some stories have also picked up something fresh from the possibility of mixing sources.
